meta.name: resemble-detect
meta.description: Deepfake detection and media safety — detect AI-generated audio, images, video, and text, trace synthesis sources, apply watermarks, verify speaker identity, and analyze media intelligence using Resemble AI

copy.tagline: 检测AI生成的音视频、图像和文本，验证媒体真实性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要识别AI合成内容并验证媒体来源真实性
copy.tagline_en: Detect AI-generated audio, video, images, and text to verify media authenticity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify AI-synthesized content and verify media source authenticity

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以检测音频、图片、视频和文本是否由AI生成，识别合成来源，应用或检测水印，验证说话人身份，并分析媒体内容。
howto.when: 当用户要求检查媒体是否AI生成、检测深度伪造、验证真实性、溯源合成平台、分析媒体信息或匹配说话人身份时触发。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can detect if audio, image, video, or text is AI-generated, trace synthesis sources, apply or detect watermarks, verify speaker identity, and analyze media content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to check if media is AI-generated, detect deepfakes, verify authenticity, trace sources, analyze media intelligence, or match speaker identity.

say_en.text: Check if this audio is AI-generated.
